purpose: Prospective new-target archive search; evaluate real control alert occupancy and reverse-cadence pseudo-directional alerts; full-tile injection recovery.

selection.rule: Extract exact HIP<number>_S names from public metadata; exclude previous targets, sort by SHA256('R11-20261117|'+target), inspect first 32 names; first four eligible consecutive S/R/S/R high-resolution Parkes scans, metadata only; prefer post-2019 March then earliest timestamp; max five cadence header attempts per target. Freeze manifest before reading powers.

calibration.scope: Full input spectral tile including all time rows and all channels; one deterministic track per OFF scan/tile, paired across amplitudes, add raw one-channel power proportional to row robust noise, same full-window blind search incl top-five cap; endpoints <=2 bins; no adaptive thresholds.

control.scope: Search both OFF scans using identical ON anchor thresholds; count any returned alert, capped count and template exposure. Reverse R/S/R (OFF1, ON2, OFF2) applies same directional gate as S/R/S. Real OFF backgrounds are not known signal-free, and not independent Bernoulli trials; report empirical proxy not calibrated cosmic false-alarm probability.

claims: No confirmed technosignature or independent confirmation. Archive reanalysis only; no flux calibration, no new observations.
